entities.summary: The house-museum of Niyazi is a memorial museum dedicated to the Azerbaijani conductor and composer, People's Artist of the USSR, Niyazi. It is located in the capital of Azerbaijan, the city of Baku, Bulbul avenue. The museum is a branch of the Azerbaijan State Museum of Musical Culture.
